name: Casa de la Rosa
style: A small whitewashed Andalusian courtyard house with a tile roof, a wooden tablao at the front and a mirrored rehearsal floor beside it.
why: She is a star about to premiere, but a warm and patient one, so she asked for a real stage and a mirror to practise in front of, with a little patio where friends can pull up a chair and watch. The red, black and white come straight from her skirt, shoes and rose.
faces_why: She was the last of the first toons to be looked after, so the first thing every new arrival sees is her stage and a seat waiting for them.

materials.look: thick lime-washed stucco, softly lumpy, bright white in the sun
curved clay barrel tiles in warm terracotta
worn oak boards inside, dark ebony boards on the stage
simple black wrought iron with little curls

areas.name: the quiet room
areas.about: Where she rests her feet after rehearsal: a low bed with a red quilt and a shuttered window.

areas.name: the camerino
areas.about: Her dressing room, with the ruffled skirts on a rail, the dance shoes in a row and a bowl of red roses by the mirror.

areas.name: the tea corner
areas.about: A snug room with a sofa, a guitar on the wall and a teapot always ready for whoever drops by.

areas.name: the rehearsal floor
areas.about: A clear sprung wooden floor with a full mirror along one wall, where she works out every step before it goes on stage.

areas.name: the tablao
areas.about: Her small raised wooden stage, made to ring under her heels, with her microphone at the front edge and one chair for the guitarist.

areas.name: the little plaza
areas.about: A paved open-air spot in front of the stage with folding chairs and potted geraniums, so friends can sit and watch.

features.about: Two whitewashed arches frame the stage like a little theatre.
A tall mirror along the side wall so she can check every turn of the skirt.
Warm bulbs strung over the seats for evening shows.
Clay pots of red geraniums, the same red as the rose in her hair.
Rose-red wooden shutters she can close when she needs her rest.
